mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%) signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger recession fears, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary easing that supports equity returns, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1300.0) signals weak residential demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1300.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals manufacturing sector contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when RSAFS < 12-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
